summary: This Form 6-K furnishes the annual general meeting (AGM) notice and related materials for Baozun Inc., a foreign private issuer. The filing sets the AGM date for June 16, 2026, in Hong Kong, with record dates for ordinary shares and ADSs. There are no special-situation proposals, merger terms, tender offers, activist campaigns, or restructuring plans described. The filing is a routine governance notice with no transformative event. As a standard AGM proxy circular under the 1934 Act, it does not trigger a special-situations classification.
